title: feat(nm2ot3slx): O freeze t+1 vs t+2 on two-axis same-lock x-probes: reverse fails, face fails, composition HOLD
science: Same as #7388 on the SAME-LOCK seed. Its own text concedes the point: 'Reverse fail and face fail agree by accident of the shared letters at A,B,C. The set at D is not equal.' This is the band half-noticing that the opposite/same-lock contrast is invisible to the verdict on x-probes.
